title: User hard-stop boundary
summary: Reach a user-level budget exactly, then demonstrate atomic rejection of the next event.

steps.title: Reach the exact limit
steps.description: Alice consumes 1,000 AI credits, worth $10 for ULB accounting.
steps.expected: The event is accepted and the ULB reaches exactly 100%.

steps.title: Attempt the next event
steps.description: Alice attempts to consume one additional AI credit.
steps.expected: The complete event is rejected by the user-level hard stop and no counter changes.
